label: Diagram 18
caption: Diagram 18 Unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet with corner WC
description: This is a floor plan of a single room, titled Diagram 18 Unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet with corner WC. The room outline is rectangular. Along the top edge a door is drawn with an open arc, and to its left a further door position is shown in dashed lines, labelled Alternative door position; at the top right corner a Sanitary dispenser is shown. The upper area contains a dashed square marked 1500mm x 1500mm wheelchair turning space, a Mirror on its left wall (Wall A), and, at the top right corner, a Disposal bin above a Shelf. The right wall carries a Finger rinse basin, Vertical grab rails, and an Alarm pull cord; the left wall has Clothes hooks. The WC is at the bottom centre, with a Drop-down rail to its left and a Wall-mounted grab rail on the right wall. Dimensions given are 2200mm min. and 750mm on the left; 140–160mm, 80–95mm, 600mm and 250mm on the right; and 150mm, 320mm, 500mm, 970mm, 1000mm min., 1500mm min. (excluding any projecting heat emitters) across the bottom. A Sanitary disposal unit and a Zone for shelf for standing users are marked on the right. At the bottom left, labels read Alternative position for alarm pull cord and Vertical grab rail. A Note reads: Layout for right-hand transfer to WC.
